source: Utah Division of Corporations — Tribal Business Entity registration & Business Entity Search
publisher: Utah Department of Commerce, Division of Corporations & Commercial Code
native_identifiability: Utah maintains a distinct 'Tribal Business Entity' registration type: an entity created by Tribal Law (nonprofit/for-profit corp, LP, LLP, LLC) registers under a Tribal option and is treated like a foreign entity authorized in Utah; the free Business Entity Records Search exposes entity name/number, principals and registered agent
identity_semantics: VALIDATION + partial ENUMERATION crossover: a filter/category that a state SOS applies specifically to tribal-law entities is rare and valuable — it lets you enumerate tribal-law entities doing business in Utah and validate their standing/principals. But 'Tribal Business Entity' means created-under-tribal-law, which is a tribal-nexus signal, NOT proof of tribal ownership percentage or member citizenship; do_not_infer ownership from the registration category
export: free public Business Entity Search (corporations.utah.gov); no confirmed bulk export — search-only until proven otherwise
notes: NEW FRAME: tribal business registries (the enumeration lead flagged 2026-09-04 from the CTA 'Tribal jurisdiction SOS' definition). Refines the 2026-08-27 'Utah state certification landscape' placeholder into a concrete, specific artifact. Worth checking whether other states expose a comparable tribal-entity category. nation_ids: [] (state validation tool, multi-nation).

publisher: U.S. Bureau of Indian Affairs, Division of Energy and Mineral Development (Business Development)
native_identifiability: Meta-source: explains and points to tribal corporation codes — the legal framework a nation enacts to charter its own corporate entities (and thus potentially run its own business registry). Not a business list; a map of which nations have the code infrastructure
identity_semantics: COVERAGE-FRAME only: identifies which tribes have corporate codes / the capacity to maintain their own entity registries — it enumerates no businesses itself. Use it to prioritize which tribal registries to hunt for, not as evidence about any business
export: BIA reference page + linked resources (IRS Tribal Business Structure Handbook; BIA 'Business Codes' / 'Choosing a Tribal Business Structure')
notes: The frame-map for this whole source class: tells us which nations can plausibly have a NNCC-style corporate registry, so the enumeration hunt is targeted rather than blind. nation_ids: [] (national reference).

source: Navajo Nation Corporation Filing Office (Business Regulatory Dept) — corporate incorporation registry
publisher: Navajo Nation Division of Economic Development, Business Regulatory Department
native_identifiability: All corporate businesses must register as a foreign or domestic corporation to operate on the Navajo Nation; the Corporation Filing Office (Karigan Complex, St Michaels, AZ) is the tribal SOS-equivalent that holds these incorporations — an enumerable corporate registry in principle
identity_semantics: DISTINCT from the Navajo NBOA Source List already in the registry (TBD-041): NBOA = a priority/certification roster of Navajo-owned businesses; this is the corporate INCORPORATION registry (any domestic/foreign corp on Navajo, Native-owned or not) — identity_mix present, do_not_infer Navajo ownership from mere incorporation. Do NOT merge with TBD-041
export: HONEST PARTIAL: no public online searchable directory surfaced this pass — filing office is physical (fee schedule PDF exists at navajoeconomy.org). Registry exists but public online access unconfirmed; converts (if at all) at first fetch/contact
notes: Prototype of the tribal-SOS enumeration lead. Bounded explicitly against TBD-041 to avoid re-proposing a known row. Access likely offline/on-request — partnership-lead shaped, not a scrapeable directory. nation_id: bia: Navajo Nation.
